verdict.rationale: Viam documents an official CLI that can call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out. The docs describe it as a complete way to operate a machine from a shell, and say an AI agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine like a person or program. The fleet management API lets users manage machines with code the same way as in the web UI, and viam-server can run against a fake config, so headless, scripted automation is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g., CI runners or actions), documented non-interactive/API-key authentication for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
